margin_separation.original_clearance_role: Required physical footprint clearance in the original controller, not a perception-error estimate.
margin_separation.uniform_allowance_role: Adapter engineering erosion, not an official rule.
margin_separation.band_observation_components: Local observed contour residual + public tile chord discrepancy + source raster pixel.

reference_evidence.comparison: Actual pixels: existing row midpoints versus visible clean outer contour offset by public half-width. No true-map offset fit.
reference_evidence.improvement: Use supported2D half-width centreline with an observed join; remove unsupported midpoint suffix; resample geometry at no more than public21/6m spacing before the original curvature/speed-profile formulas.
reference_evidence.mask_correction: Vehicle bounding box is a subpixel-recovery veto; reference joins veto actual obstacles rather than visible road in that box.
reference_evidence.filter_support_correction: Reference-only contour search window derives from1000x800->96 area filter,96->84 linear filter,84 bilinear sampling and source antialias support. Existing geometry observation allowance and legacy geometry reader are unchanged.

public_checks.scope: Finite synthetic public tile/raster tests only; no universal error bound or safety certificate.

cached_gates.fix: Physical source spacing for curvature estimation
Full public raster filter support for reference contour tracing

latest_blocker.full_measured_state_controller_compariso: Not evaluated: original frame precision assertion failed; assertion preserved.
latest_blocker.limits: Instantaneous measured-force diagnostic is not a controller admission result. Joint rates and clip history remain partly unobserved; no causal claim that state estimation alone explains the force barrier.

promotion.reason: Public/cached reference estimation improved, but full continuous live admission still fails earlier; retain as a research candidate, not a verified improvement in live performance.

next_gate: Before another live reset, construct an equivalent measured rigid-state representation that passes the existing precision guard, then separate same-candidate first1..2tick force sensitivity to hull velocity/yaw, wheel spin and joint rates. Validate any observable-state correction publicly and on the saved complete Agent input. Do not reduce original clearance/force thresholds or tune a new speed planner.
privacy: Only code/public synthetic tests/aggregate results committed. Raw images, full checkpoints, reset identity and actual state/map remain private.
